description: Record schema for an MLS delivery service profile, published by a user to advertise their DS endpoint and supported cipher suites.

main.description: An MLS profile record that declares which delivery service handles messages for this user and what cipher suites are supported.

deliveryService.description: The HTTPS endpoint URL of the user's MLS delivery service

supportedCipherSuites.description: MLS cipher suites supported by this user's delivery service
